subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should package changelog previews permit platform administrators and moderators, in addition to direct owners and authorized publisher-organization members, to read prior release content for any existing package?
rationale: The code safely gates storage reads, but the permanent set of privileged roles allowed to inspect retained release material is a repository security-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve and document the privileged access scope
options.body: Accept the direct-owner, publisher-organization, moderator, and administrator policy and add a concise durable specification for the storage-read boundary before merge.

options.title: Narrow privileged preview access
options.body: Restrict preview reads to package owners and publisher-organization roles, or define a narrower moderation workflow, then update the action and focused access tests.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the privileged access scope
recommendation.body: Accept the direct-owner, publisher-organization, moderator, and administrator policy and add a concise durable specification for the storage-read boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current-main contributor for the adjacent plugin publish flow; final authorization-policy ownership may be shared with repository security owners.
